# cantera registry

> cantera is a shadcn registry for construction (AEC) interfaces: OAuth sign-in, scope, and connection components, plus an end-to-end Autodesk (APS / ACC) sign-in block. It is not an npm package — the shadcn CLI copies the source into the consumer project, where it renders on that project's own shadcn primitives and theme.

Namespace: @cantera
Registry item URL: https://canteraui.xyz/r/{name}.json
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/{name}
Installation guide: https://canteraui.xyz/installation
Full reference for agents: https://canteraui.xyz/llms-full.txt

One-time setup — add the namespace to components.json, then install items by name:

```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@cantera": "https://canteraui.xyz/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

## Items

### oauth-types

Title: OAuth Types
Type: lib
Description: Generic OAuth types for cantera components: providers, scopes, connections, accounts. The lingua franca adapters translate into.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @cantera/oauth-types
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/oauth-types
Item: https://canteraui.xyz/r/oauth-types.json

### aps-oauth-preset

Title: APS OAuth Preset
Type: lib
Description: Autodesk Platform Services (ACC) preset: provider metadata, scope catalog, scope bundles, and adapters into cantera's oauth types.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @cantera/aps-oauth-preset
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/aps-oauth-preset
Item: https://canteraui.xyz/r/aps-oauth-preset.json

### status-tokens

Title: Status Tokens
Type: tokens (CSS variables only, no files)
Description: Semantic status colors — success, warning, danger, neutral — each with a foreground and a surface companion, contrast-verified in light and dark. The palette every cantera status surface renders from.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @cantera/status-tokens
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/status-tokens
Item: https://canteraui.xyz/r/status-tokens.json

### provider-sign-in-button

Title: Provider Sign-In Button
Type: component
Description: A sign-in button for a single OAuth provider: brand icon, label, loading state. Works as a link or a click handler.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @cantera/provider-sign-in-button
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/provider-sign-in-button
Item: https://canteraui.xyz/r/provider-sign-in-button.json

### sign-in-card

Title: Sign-In Card
Type: component
Description: A multi-provider sign-in chooser card. Server-renderable via an href template, or client-driven via a callback.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @cantera/sign-in-card
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/sign-in-card
Item: https://canteraui.xyz/r/sign-in-card.json

### scope-picker

Title: Scope Picker
Type: component
Description: A controlled OAuth scope picker: checkbox list with descriptions, one-click presets, required scopes pinned on, and an escape hatch for scopes outside the catalog.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @cantera/scope-picker
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/scope-picker
Item: https://canteraui.xyz/r/scope-picker.json

### user-account-badge

Title: User Account Badge
Type: component
Description: An avatar-and-name chip for a connected account, with optional provider mark. Server-safe.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @cantera/user-account-badge
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/user-account-badge
Item: https://canteraui.xyz/r/user-account-badge.json

### token-status

Title: Token Status
Type: component
Description: Status line for an OAuth grant: connection state, token expiry, and held scopes. Server-safe.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @cantera/token-status
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/token-status
Item: https://canteraui.xyz/r/token-status.json

### connection-card

Title: Connection Card
Type: component
Description: A provider connection at a glance: account, grant status, scopes, and disconnect / reconnect actions.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @cantera/connection-card
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/connection-card
Item: https://canteraui.xyz/r/connection-card.json

### acc-sign-in

Title: ACC Sign-In
Type: block
Description: Complete Autodesk (APS / ACC) sign-in flow on aec-auth: consent redirect, code exchange, vault-managed refresh, signed session, and a live connection panel.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @cantera/acc-sign-in
Docs: https://canteraui.xyz/components/acc-sign-in
Item: https://canteraui.xyz/r/acc-sign-in.json
